Real Estate Salespeople/Agent Seminar

We know many real estate agents are doing the right thing, so tax returns where personal expenses have been claimed or other expenses have been inflated stand out. In this seminar, we'll help you get it right from the start with information about expenses, good record keeping, GST and the wage subsidy. 

Stay up-to-date with getting your taxes right as a Real Estate Salesperson/Agent: 
https://www.ird.govt.nz/real-estate-agents

Whether you're already in business or considering setting up a real estate agency, you can make an appointment to see us. We run free seminars and workshops online and in person on topics like income tax, GST and becoming an employer. Find out more about our upcoming seminars: https://www.ird.govt.nz/seminars

----------------------------------------------------------------

Follow us on social media for help with general queries relating to any of Inland Revenue's products and services: 

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/IRDNZ/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/NZInlandRevenue
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/inland-revenue-nz/

The Interislander Journey

Interislander has been connecting New Zealand across Cook Strait for over 60 years.

🔍 Find us on https://instagram.com/interislander_nz & https://facebook.com/Interislander

⛴️ Book now on https://interislander.co.nz

We are the original Cook Strait Ferry. We sail between the North and South Islands (Wellington and Picton) every day, carrying passengers and freight. Along with the breathtaking views, enjoy our locally sourced cuisine, cinemas, free kids activities and premium lounges.

One of the best summer jobs around. Find out more about being a Cabin Attendant on Interislander.

Are you a student looking work in the hospitality industry over summer, or do you want a change in role and to work for one of New Zealand’s most iconic brands?

Welcome to ‘Epetoma o te reo Māori Kūki ‘Āirani – Cook Islands Language Week

The Secretary for Pacific Peoples, Gerardine Clifford-Lidstone welcomes you to join the celebrations for ‘Epetoma o te reo Māori Kūki ‘Āirani – Cook Islands Language Week.
This year’s theme is 'Ātuitui’ia au ki te au peu o tōku kāinga Ipukarea, which means, "connect me to the traditions & culture of my homeland".

Resources and calendar of events found right here:
https://www.mpp.govt.nz/programmes/pacific-language-weeks/cook-islands-language-week/

Kiribati Language Week 2023 Phrase of the Day: Tai Tamwarakea te kairirieta bwa e kati oina

Join us as we honour Kiribati culture and language with a beautiful proverb shared by Rose Alya Tawaia from the Otago Kiribati Community.

🌳 "Do not climb a tall tree as the trunk could be slippery." 🌿
This ancient Kiribati wisdom reminds us to respect our elders and cherish their wisdom, for they hold the key to a fruitful life. Let's embrace the richness of our heritage and language during this special week.

#KiribatiLanguageWeek #CultureandHeritage #RespectforElders #EmbracingWisdom #KiribatiPride

Kiribati Language Week 2023 Word of the Day: Kabwaia

🌺 Join us in celebrating the richness of Kiribati language and culture with a special video featuring Temarewe Biremon from Otago Kiribati Community. 

In this inspiring clip, she shares the beautiful word of the day, 'kabwaia,' which means success and blessings. Let's embrace the power of language and spread positivity together. 

Tag someone who brings success and blessings into your life! 🙌🏽💫 #KiribatiLanguageWeek #EmbracingCulture #Kabwaia #SuccessAndBlessings

Kiribati Language Week Phrase of the Day - Unikia ko na manga kana uaana

Josery Rereiti from the Otago Kiribati Community shares the wisdom of our ancestors: 'Unikia ko na manga kana uaana' meaning 'You will eat what you sow.' 

Let's remember to always approach with love and respect, knowing that when we do good to others, goodness will come back to us. 🤝💕

#KiribatiLanguageWeek
